## About
At Tire Store Service Center our motto is simple: we don't sell, we service. Our Telephone Rd shop in Houston is part of a small group of locations serving drivers across Houston, Alvin and Manvel.
We try to offer good service and fair prices, with qualified technicians and the fastest turnaround we can manage. Come in for tires from brands like Bridgestone, Firestone and Toyo, or for alignments, oil changes, steering and suspension work. We also help with ATV tires, farm tires and lift kits.
Gerardo manages the Telephone Rd location. Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 82 Google reviews, and many of them came to us on a friend's referral.

## Services
- Tires from great brands: Car, truck and SUV tires from brands including Bridgestone, Firestone and Toyo.
- Tire services: Computer spin balancing, TPMS service and adjustments, flat tire repairs and tire rotations.
- Auto repairs: Oil changes, steering and suspension repairs, wheel alignments and more.
- ATV and farm tire help: We can help with your ATV or farm tire needs, not just your daily driver.

## FAQ
Q: When is the Telephone Rd shop open?
A: Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Saturday hours are shorter, and we're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you offer a discount for first responders or veterans?
A: Yes. First responders and veterans save 5% off labor.

Q: Is there Wi-Fi while I wait?
A: Yes, there's free Wi-Fi, so you can catch up on work or browse the web while we take care of your vehicle.
